facts.statement: Nemegtonykus is a genus of alvarezsaurid dinosaur from the Late Cretaceous Nemegt Formation of Mongolia.
facts.quote: Nemegtonykus (meaning "Nemegt claw") is a genus of alvarezsaurid dinosaur from the Late Cretaceous ( Maastrichtian) Nemegt Formation of Mongolia.

facts.statement: The only known species in the genus is Nemegtonykus citus.
facts.quote: The type and only species is Nemegtonykus citus.

facts.statement: Nemegtonykus citus was named and described in 2019 by Lee Sungjin, Park Jin-Young, Lee Yuong-Nam, Kim Su-Hwan, Lü Junchang, Rinchen Barsbold, and Khishigjav Tsogtbaatar.
facts.quote: In 2019, the type species Nemegtonykus citus was named and described by Lee Sungjin, Park Jin-Young, Lee Yuong-Nam, Kim Su-Hwan, Lü Junchang, Rinchen Barsbold and Khishigjav Tsogtbaatar.

facts.statement: The generic name Nemegtonykus combines a reference to the Nemegt Formation with the Greek word for claw, analogous to Mononykus.
facts.quote: The generic name combines a reference to the Nemegt with a Greek ὄνυξ, onyx, "claw", analogous to Mononykus.

facts.statement: The specific name citus means "the fast one" in Latin.
facts.quote: The specific name means "the fast one" in Latin.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen MPC-D 100/203 was found in a layer of the Nemegt Formation dating to perhaps the late Campanian to early Maastrichtian.
facts.quote: The holotype, MPC-D 100/203, was found in a layer of the Nemegt Formation (perhaps late Campanian - early Maastrichtian).

facts.statement: Nemegtonykus lived during the late Cretaceous, approximately 75 to 71 million years ago between the Campanian and Maastrichtian stages, in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 75 y 71 millones de años entre el Campaniense y Maastrichtiense, en lo que hoy es Asia.

facts.statement: Nemegtonykus is classified within the family Alvarezsauridae.
Nemegtonykus belongs to the subfamily Parvicursorinae.
The time range for Nemegtonykus is the Maastrichtian, from 72.2 to 66 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Maastrichtian to Maastrichtian (72.2 to 66 million years ago)

facts.statement: Nemegtonykus is the second alvarezsaurid known from the Nemegt Formation, following Mononykus.
facts.quote: It is the second alvarezsaurid known from the Nemegt Formation, preceded by Mononykus.

rejected.statement: The holotype consists of a partial skeleton lacking the skull, containing six back vertebrae, two sacral vertebrae, twenty-one tail vertebrae, five ribs, the left shoulder girdle, the left pubic bone, parts of other pelvic bones, the left hindlimb, and the right shinbone.
rejected.quote: It consists of a partial skeleton lacking the skull. It contains six back vertebrae, two sacral vertebrae, twenty-one tail vertebrae, five ribs, the left shoulder girdle, the left pubic bone, parts of other pelvic bones, the left hindlimb and the right shinbone.
